title: Primitives
description: Deterministic facts about the tool calls of one Droid session, written by recorder/capture/primitives.py. A call stores classes, counts, and repo paths. It never stores command text or tool output.

session_id.description: Id of the recorded session. Matches session_id in runs/traces.

assistant_turns.description: Number of assistant messages in the Droid transcript. Each one is one model call.

token_usage.description: Session totals from the Droid settings.json tokenUsage. There is no per-turn usage. output_tokens includes thinking_tokens.

timed_out.description: True when the run was killed by the timeout (droid_exit 124 in meta.json).

tool_call_id.description: The tool_use id. Matches tool_call_id in the trace. A trace drops a failed call that comes before the first snapshot, so a call can be missing from the trace.

position.description: 0-based order of the call in the session.

turn.description: 0-based index of the assistant turn that issued the call. Parallel calls share a turn.

command_class.description: File tools map by tool: Read is read, Grep and Glob are search, Edit and Create are edit. A shell command takes its highest-ranked part in this order: test, install, sleep_or_wait, run, vcs, edit, search, read. run is a script or inline interpreter call. edit covers sed -i, cp, mv, rm, patch, and a redirect into a file. other is anything else.

test_runner.description: Runner of the first test command in a shell call. A python -c call to sympy.test counts as sympy_bin_test. go test is go_test, and ansible-test units, sanity, or integration is ansible_test. Null when the call runs no test.

path_arg_count.description: Test path, node-id, package, or dotted-label arguments of the first test command. 0 is a whole-suite run (go test ./... counts as 0). Null when the call runs no test.

background.description: The command ends with &, uses nohup or setsid, sets fireAndForget, or the tool reports a background run.

duration_s.description: Seconds from the tool_use line to the start of the capture hook for the call, which is when the tool finishes. Without a hook record, to the tool_result line. Parallel calls can include the time of earlier siblings. Null when the call has no result.

is_error.description: The is_error flag of the tool result. Null when the call has no result.

exit_code.description: Exit code printed in the shell tool result. Null for other tools, for a background run, and when the call has no result.

files.description: Repo-relative paths from the tool input of a file tool, or the test path arguments of a shell test command, without arguments built by shell expansion. A path outside the checkout stays absolute. Never other command text.

output_chars.description: Length of the tool result text. Null when the call has no result.

output_tokens_est.description: Estimate: output_chars divided by 4, rounded down. The transcript has no per-call token counts.

turns_after.description: Assistant turns after the turn that issued the call.

repeats_earlier.description: An earlier call has the same tool_name and the same input. A shell command compares with whitespace collapsed and ignores the summary and timeout fields.
